source: We played the guessing game with Aunt Sal after dinner. She described a lighthouse as “a very tall torch with responsibilities,” and none of us could improve on that. Ben guessed volcano, which sent her into another fit of laughter. We never finished keeping score. By the last round, guessing correctly seemed less useful than giving Sal another reason to invent something.
